plain_english: The Lord says he will speak his supreme word again to Arjuna, who is pleased, out of desire for his welfare.
sanskrit_cite: atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ   prāktanairnavabhiradhyāyairya evārtho lakṣitaḥ sa eva  pratipadapāṭhairasminnadhyāye pratāyate | tathā cāha-bhūya  eva-iti | uktamevārthaṃ sphuṭīkartuṃ punaḥ kathyamānaṃ  śṛṇviti | arjuno'pyevamevābhidhāsyati-bhūyaḥ kathaya  iti-ityadhyāyatātparyam | śiṣṭaṃ nigadavyākhyātamiti kiṃ  punaruktena | saṃdigdhaṃ tu nirṇeṣyate | śrībhagavānuvāca   bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | yatte'haṃ  prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā

plain_english: Neither gods nor great sages know his origin; he is indeed the beginning of gods and great sages in every way.
sanskrit_cite: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ | ahamādirhi  devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ

plain_english: Whoever knows me as unborn, beginningless, and great lord of the world, being undeluded, is freed from all sins among mortals.
sanskrit_cite: yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram | asammūḍhaḥ sa  martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

plain_english: Intelligence, knowledge, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calm, pleasure, pain, becoming, being, fear, fearlessness, non-delusion, and zeal are listed.
sanskrit_cite: buddhirjñānamasammohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ | sukhaṃ  duḥkhaṃ bhavo bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca | asaṃmohaḥ-utsāhaḥ

plain_english: Non-harm, equanimity, contentment, austerity, giving, fame, and infamy become various states of beings from me alone.
sanskrit_cite: ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo'yaśaḥ | bhavanti bhāvā  bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ

plain_english: The seven former great sages and four Manus are born from my mind-born nature, and these creatures of the world are theirs.
sanskrit_cite: maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā | madbhāvā mānasā  jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ

plain_english: Whoever truly knows this glory and yoga is united by unshaken yoga; there is no doubt here.
sanskrit_cite: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ | so'vikampena  yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

plain_english: I am the source of all; all proceeds from me; thus the wise, endowed with devotion, worship me.
sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo itaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate | iti matvā bhajante  māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ

plain_english: With minds fixed on me and lives gone to me, they enlighten and tell of me always, delighting one another through mutual knowing; all knowers are one Lord, attained easily by pervasion.
sanskrit_cite: maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam | kathayantaśca māṃ  nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramayanti ca | parasparabodhanayā anyonyabodhasphārasaṃkramaṇāt sarva eva hi  pramātāra eka īśvaraḥ-iti vitatavyāptyā sukhenaiva  sarvaśaktikasarvagatasvātmarūpatādhigamena māheśvaryameṣāmiti  bhāvaḥ

plain_english: To those constantly united and worshipping with love, I give that wisdom-yoga by which they reach me.
sanskrit_cite: teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam | dadāmi  buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māṃ prāpayanti te

plain_english: For their compassion, I, abiding in self-state, destroy ignorance-born darkness with the shining lamp of knowledge.
sanskrit_cite: teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ | nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā

plain_english: Arjuna said: you are supreme Brahman, supreme abode, pure, highest person, eternal, divine first god, unborn, all-pervading.
sanskrit_cite: arjuna uvāca   paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān | puruṣaṃ  śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum

plain_english: The sages all say this of you, and likewise the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; you yourself also speak to me.
sanskrit_cite: āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā | asito devalo  vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi mām

plain_english: I think all this is true, O Kesava, that you speak to me; for neither gods nor great sages know your manifestation, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanme vadasi keśava | na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ  vidurdevā mahaṣayaḥ

plain_english: You yourself know yourself by yourself, O best of persons, creator of beings, lord of beings, god of gods, lord of the world.
sanskrit_cite: svayamevātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama | bhūtabhāvana  bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate

plain_english: You should tell completely the auspicious glories of yourself, by which glories you pervade and stand in all these worlds.
sanskrit_cite: vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa vibhūtīrātmanaḥ śubhāḥ | yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi

plain_english: How may I know you, O yogi, while I consider you? In which and which states are you to be thought, O Lord, by me?
sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāmahaṃ paricintayan | keṣu keṣu ca  bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā

plain_english: Tell again in detail your yoga and glory, O Janardana; for there is no satisfaction for me hearing this nectar.
sanskrit_cite: vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana | bhūyaḥ kathaya  tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam

plain_english: The blessed Lord said: indeed, I will tell you my auspicious glories chiefly, best of Kurus; there is no end to my expansion.
sanskrit_cite: śrībhagavānuvāca   hanta te kathayiṣyāmi vibhūtirātmānaḥ śubhāḥ | prādhānyataḥ  kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me

plain_english: I am the self, Guḍākeśa, dwelling in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, middle, and indeed the end of beings.
sanskrit_cite: ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ | ahamādiśca madhyaṃ  ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca

plain_english: Among Ādityas I am Viṣṇu, among lights the sun with rays; among Maruts I am Marīci, and among stars I am the moon.
sanskrit_cite: ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān | marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī

plain_english: Among Vedas I am the Sāmaveda; among gods I am Vāsava; among senses I am mind; among beings I am consciousness.
sanskrit_cite: vedānāṃ sāmavedo'haṃ devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ  manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā

plain_english: Among Rudras I am Śaṅkara; among Yakṣas and Rākṣasas I am the lord of wealth; among Vasus I am fire; among peaks I am Meru.
sanskrit_cite: rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām | vasūnāṃ  pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham

plain_english: And know, Pārtha, Bṛhaspati as chief among priests; among army leaders I am Skanda; among rivers I am the ocean.
sanskrit_cite: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ viddhi pārtha | bṛhaspatim | senānyāmapyahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ

plain_english: Among great sages I am Bhṛgu; among speeches the one imperishable syllable; among sacrifices the sacrifice of muttered prayer; among immovable things Himalaya.
sanskrit_cite: maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmapyekamakṣaram | yajñānāṃ  japayajño'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ

plain_english: Among all trees the sacred fig tree; among divine sages Nārada; among gandharvas Citraratha; among perfected ones Kapila the sage.
sanskrit_cite: aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ | gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ

plain_english: Know me as the swift one among horses, Airāvata among lordly elephants, and the lord of men among men.
sanskrit_cite: uccaiḥ śravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam | airāvataṃ  gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam

plain_english: I am the thunderbolt among weapons, the wish-cow among cows, Kandarpa as procreation, and Vāsuki among serpents.
sanskrit_cite: āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk | prajanaścāsmi  kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ

plain_english: I am Ananta among serpents, Varuṇa among aquatic beings, Aryaman among ancestors, and Yama among controllers.
sanskrit_cite: anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham | pitṛṇāmaryamā  cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham

plain_english: I am Prahlāda among daityas, time among those who reckon, the lion king among beasts, and Vainateya among birds.
sanskrit_cite: prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham | mṛgāṇāṃ ca  mṛgendro'haṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām

plain_english: I am the wind among purifiers, Rama among weapon-bearers, the makara among fishes, and the Ganga among rivers.
sanskrit_cite: pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham | jhaṣāṇāṃ  makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī

plain_english: Of creations I am the beginning, the end, and the middle too, O Arjuna; of knowledges, self-knowledge; of debates, I am the speech among speakers.
sanskrit_cite: sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna | adhyātmavidyā  vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham

plain_english: Of letters I am the a-sound, and the dual among compounds; I am imperishable time, and I the ordainer facing all directions.
sanskrit_cite: akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca | ahamevākṣayaḥ  kālo dhātā'haṃ viśvatomukhaḥ

plain_english: Death is all-seizing and the origin of I among future things; fame, prosperity, and speech belong to women; memory, intelligence, steadfastness, and forgiveness are also named.
sanskrit_cite: mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām | kīrtiḥ  śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā

plain_english: Among the samans I am the Brihat-saman; among meters I am Gayatri; among months I am Margashirsha; among seasons I am the flower-maker.
sanskrit_cite: bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham | māsānāṃ  mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ

plain_english: I am gambling among the fraudulent, splendor among the splendid, victory, resolve, and goodness among the good.
sanskrit_cite: dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham | jayo'smi  vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham

plain_english: Among the Vṛṣṇis I am Vāsudeva; among the Pāṇḍavas, Dhanañjaya; among sages, Vyāsa; among poets, Uśanas the poet.
sanskrit_cite: vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ | munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ

plain_english: I am the rod among punishers, policy among conquerors; and indeed I am silence among secrets, knowledge among knowers.
sanskrit_cite: daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām | maunaṃ caivāsmi  guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham

plain_english: Whatever is the seed of all beings, that I am, Arjuna; nothing exists without me, no being moving or still.
sanskrit_cite: yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna | na tadasti vinā  yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram

plain_english: There is no end, Parantapa, to my divine glories; this extent of glory has been spoken by me briefly.
sanskrit_cite: nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa | eṣa  tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā

plain_english: Whatever being is glorious, splendid, or mighty, know that very thing, you, to be born of a spark of my splendor.
sanskrit_cite: yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā | tattadevāvagaccha  tvaṃ mama tejoṃśasambhavam

plain_english: Or else, what is the use of much knowledge for you, Arjuna? Supporting this whole world, I stand with one part. I am the Self. This teaching prevents a distinction that would otherwise break the vision of Brahman; all this is the Lord's principle, manifested in various forms and becoming the object of all.
sanskrit_cite: athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñānena tavārjuna | viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ  kṛtsnamekāṃśena jagatsthitaḥ | ahamātmā ityanena vyavacchedaṃ nivārayati anyathā sthāvarāṇāṃ  himālayaḥ ityādivākyeṣu himālaya eva bhagavānnānyaḥ iti  vyavacchedena nirvibhāgatvābhāvāt brahmadarśanaṃ  khaṇḍitamabhaviṣyat | yato yasyākhaṇḍākāravyāptistathā cetasi  nopārohati tāṃ ca jijñāsati tasyāyamupadeśagranthaḥ | tathāhi | upasaṃhāre bhedābhedavādaṃ-yadyadvibhūtimatsattvam  ityanenābhidhāya paścādabhedamevopasaṃharati-   athavā bahunaitena* * * * * * * * * viṣṭabhyāham * * * * * *  ekāṃśena jagatsthitaḥ | iti | uktaṃ hi-   pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi | iti | prajānāṃ sṛṣṭihetuḥ sarvamidaṃ bhagavattattvameva  taistairvicitrai rūpairbhāvyamānaṃ sakalasya viṣayatāṃ yātīti  śivam

plain_english: Here is the summary verse: whatever comes within desire or sense, forcibly dissolve it and meditate peaceful brahman. Thus in the Gita meaning-gathering composed by Abhinavagupta, tenth chapter.
sanskrit_cite: atra saṃgrahaślokaḥ   icchāyāmindriye vāpi yadevāyāti gocaram | haṭhādvilāpayaṃstattatpraśāntaṃ brahma bhāvayet | iti śrīmahāmaheśvarācāryavaryarājānakābhinavaguptapādaviracite  śrīmadbhagavadgītārthasaṃgrahe daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
